definitions.explanation: A round fruit with red or green skin.

examples.japanese: りんごを{三|みっ}つ{買|か}った。
りんごの{皮|かわ}を{剥|む}いてから{食|た}べます。
examples.english: I peel the apple before eating it.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になるとりんごがおいしくなるので、{毎年|まいとし}りんご{狩|が}りに{行|い}きます。
examples.english: Apples become delicious in autumn, so I go apple picking every year.

notes:
りんご is typically written in hiragana, though the kanji {林檎|りんご} exists.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- りんごを{剥|む}く: to peel an apple
- りんごを{切|き}る: to cut an apple
- りんご{狩|が}り: apple picking
- りんご{酢|す}: apple vinegar

VARIETIES:
- ふじ: Fuji (most popular variety)
- つがる: Tsugaru
- {紅玉|こうぎょく}: Jonathan apple

COMPOUNDS:
- りんごジュース: apple juice
- りんご{飴|あめ}: candied apple
- りんごパイ: apple pie

{青森県|あおもりけん} is Japan's top apple-producing region, accounting for over half of domestic production. The phrase 「りんごが{赤|あか}くなると{医者|いしゃ}が{青|あお}くなる」means apples are considered very healthy.
